top_choice_rationale: P003 is a single, attributable discovery with two clear names: Rees determined the nitrogenase MoFe and Fe protein structures and Einsle resolved the iron-molybdenum cofactor at atomic resolution and assigned the central carbide. The results are independently confirmed, including by recent cryo-EM of turnover states, and define the metal cluster on which all mechanistic discussion of biological N2 reduction rests. The citation is limited to structure, so it does not claim a catalytic mechanism that remains open. I recognise it has the thinnest committee support and that this prize would honour structure rather than a closed mechanism.
recusal_note: None apparent from profile. P003 lies in biological bioenergetics and metalloenzyme mechanism, close to my own field, but I have no stated personal or institutional tie to Rees or Einsle. Xiaodong Zou is a Stockholm University colleague but is not a proposed laureate.
